description: The Astera on Al Marjan Island, RAK combines Aston Martin interiors with direct beach access. 1-3 bed residences and villas. Register interest.

faq_pairs.question: What is The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
faq_pairs.answer: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.

faq_pairs.question: What unit types and sizes are available at The Astera?
faq_pairs.answer: The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

faq_pairs.question: What did Aston Martin design at The Astera?
faq_pairs.answer: Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.

faq_pairs.question: When will The Astera be completed?
faq_pairs.answer: The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

faq_pairs.question: Where exactly is The Astera located?
faq_pairs.answer: The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.

faq_pairs.question: What amenities does The Astera offer?
faq_pairs.answer: Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

faq_pairs.question: Is The Astera a good investment in Ras Al Khaimah?
faq_pairs.answer: Al Marjan Island is an emerging market where average apartment capital values rose approximately 35% in a single year. Branded residences historically command price premiums of 30 to 200% over comparable unbranded stock, and the Wynn Resort announcement has been directly linked to market price doubling over two years. Buyers should seek independent investment advice.

faq_pairs.question: What is the UAE Golden Visa benefit for buyers at The Astera?
faq_pairs.answer: Buyers investing 2 million AED or more in UAE real estate may apply for a 10-year Golden Visa. The UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax, providing a tax-efficient holding environment for both resident and international buyers.

faq_pairs.question: How does the Wynn Resort affect Al Marjan Island property values?
faq_pairs.answer: The announcement of the Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East, has been directly linked to a doubling of market prices over the past two years. The resort will be approximately 5 minutes from The Astera and is expected to drive further tourism and rental demand for beachfront properties on the island.

faq_pairs.question: How do I register interest or buy at The Astera?
faq_pairs.answer: Buyers can register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can provide current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

faq_pairs.question: What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

faq_pairs.question: When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?

faq_pairs.question: Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
faq_pairs.answer: The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.

faq_pairs.question: Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
faq_pairs.answer: Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.

faq_pairs.question: What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
faq_pairs.answer: The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.

faq_pairs.question: What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
faq_pairs.answer: Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.

faq_pairs.question: Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?

faq_pairs.question: How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
